item.title: Despite slow gains, Cradle Cincinnati continues to drill down on ways to decrease infant mortality
item.description: The infant mortality rate, or the death of an infant before its first birthday, continues to remain high among Black families. Efforts in Cincinnati and beyond have made some progress to lower it, including recognizing the importance of doulas and educating both healthcare providers and moms. How effective is this strategy and can more be done? item.title: For Dayton’s County Corp, creating generational wealth is the foundation - CET
item.description: Dayton and Montgomery County, like so many other places in the U.S., continue to face a shortage of low-income housing. For nearly fifty years the private nonprofit development corporation County Corp, has been creating generational wealth by adding new housing and working to revitalize neighborhoods.
